score_details.title: Global shares edge higher as central banks double down on inflation fight

score_details.reason: Negative systemic take on the AI-led market narrative — suggests AI exuberance is fragile and could transmit to broader market stress. High relevance because AI is a dominant leadership theme for equities.

score_details.reason: Extremely high options volume signals concentrated positioning and elevated tail-risk/volatility risk for equities. This increases the probability of sharp moves and is a negative for complacent risk-taking.

score_details.title: In China, A.I. Is Moving Forward While the Economy Lags Behind
score_details.reason: China-specific: AI progress versus weak macro suggests bifurcation — positive for selective Chinese tech names but negative for broader China equity exposure, so net mildly negative for global equities given China’s weight.

score_details.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang emerges as Trump's top ally in AI safety debate
score_details.reason: Reinforces Nvidia's and big-tech leadership in the AI narrative and signals political access/support that can reduce regulatory tail risks for large AI incumbents — positive for tech leadership and market sentiment.

score_details.title: Big Tech uses guarantees to keep $300bn AI exposure off balance sheets
